# Grug Digital

> Grug Digital makes game asset packs, playful web tools and games, and is building a new gaming platform and engine.
> The old site is still served at its old paths.

## Asset packs

- [Asset packs on itch.io](https://polysw.itch.io/): low-poly 3D packs (avatar accessories, characters, pets, game kits).
- [The list as JSON](https://grugdigital.com/api/itch-assets): every pack with its price, description, cover and itch link,
  grouped into categories.

## Building Studio (textured buildings)

- [Building Studio](https://grugdigital.com/build/): a browser app (WebGL) that makes a chunky building (width, depth,
  wall height, foundation, a flat/gable/hip/shed roof, floors, a door and windows per wall), has Gemini (Nano Banana)
  paint a colour-coded two-view reference sheet of it, lines the painting back up and bakes it into a retro-textured
  `.glb` with a bevel normal map. One unit is one metre; doors are sized for a 1.8 m figure.
- [Guide for Claude and other AI agents](https://grugdigital.com/build/claude.md): the settings, the
  `window.GrugBuild` JavaScript API and settings links (`/build/?w=8&d=6&roof=gable&desc=…`).
- [Example buildings](https://grugdigital.com/build/examples/): six finished buildings (medieval, modern, future) with
  their reference sheets, Gemini paintings and `.glb` files, each openable as a template.
- [Claude skill (zip)](https://grugdigital.com/build/game-buildings.zip): install it so Claude uses the studio
  whenever a game needs buildings, and brings them into the game.

## Avatar Studio (Roblox characters)

- [Avatar Studio](https://grugdigital.com/character/): a browser app (WebGL) that makes a blocky Roblox R6
  character: hair, face, a custom shirt and pants painted with an AI image editor (Gemini / Nano Banana), and a rigged
  `.glb` download.
- [Guide for Claude and other AI agents](https://grugdigital.com/character/claude.md): how to make a character
  for someone who pasted the studio's link into a chat, step by step, including the `window.GrugStudio` JavaScript API
  and recipe links (`/character/?hair=…&outfit=…`) for when you can't use a browser.
- [Claude skill (zip)](https://grugdigital.com/character/roblox-characters.zip): install it so Claude uses the
  studio whenever a Roblox game needs characters or NPCs, and brings them into the game.

## For agents

- [Grug for agents](https://grugdigital.com/agents/): both studios on one page, with prompts to copy and send to an
  agent, the two skills and links to their source on GitHub.
